verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a supervised or copilot mode in which the agent drafts replies that a human approves before they reach the customer. The nearby features are different things: pre-deployment simulations, response guardrails that block, rewrite or escalate, human handoff when the AI can't resolve a conversation, and limiting deployment to trained topics. None of these is a draft-and-approve workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I can launch in a supervised mode where the agent drafts replies for human approval before anything reaches a customer
